members.name: tagPlacement
members.doc: Where the tags sit: inline with the input, or below it.

members.name: size
members.doc: The field's size.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: The hint shown in the input while it is empty, and beside the tags when they sit below.

members.name: value
members.doc: The tags, when the caller controls them.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting tags, when the field controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with all of the tags each time one is added or removed.

members.name: onTagAdded
members.doc: Called with the tag that was just added.

members.name: onTagRemoved
members.doc: Called with the tag that was just removed.

members.name: allowDuplicates
members.doc: Lets the same tag be added more than once.

members.name: maxTags
members.doc: The most tags the field holds; adding another does nothing.

members.name: validate
members.doc: Decides whether a typed tag may be added.

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the input.

members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message shown, in place of the description, while the field is invalid.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the field disabled.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required.
